title: Daughter of the Lake

outfit_card.silhouette: A fitted lace corset bodice flaring into a voluminous multi-tiered tulle and satin skirt, featuring dramatic sheer detached sleeves and a sweeping lace veil that creates a soft, aquatic asymmetry.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: A scalloped Chantilly lace bonnet veiled in cascading sheer tulle, accented with a delicate silver fish-motif hairpin and pearl drop ornaments.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: An off-shoulder sweetheart corset in pale aqua satin, heavily encrusted with silver filigree, opalescent sequins, and cascading pearl chains, paired with sheer, detached white lace sleeves gloved to the forearm.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: A layered A-line skirt of sheer aqua tulle over a pearlescent satin petticoat, featuring a high-low hemline, pearl fringe swags, and an asymmetrical trailing sash, finished with crystal-embellished pointed heels.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: A large, sweeping tulle veil that mirrors the movement of water, alongside scattered floating pearl drops and delicate silver fish-scale motifs integrated into the ensemble.
